Send One Request to the WildObs API and Return Its Records

Source: R/wildobs_dp_download.R
dot-wildobs_api_find.Rd

Posts one find request to the WildObs API and returns the records it holds. A request that fails, returns a non-200 status, or returns a body without records is retried, pausing 2 then 4 seconds, because one dropped request among the hundreds a large media download makes should not discard the whole download. A rejected API key (401 or 403) is not retried, since trying again cannot help.

Usage

.wildobs_api_find(url, api_key, body, what, attempts = 3)

Arguments

url

Character. The API find endpoint.

api_key

Character. The user's WildObs API key.

body

List. The request body: collection, filter and any sort or limit.

what

Character. A short description of the request, used in the error.

attempts

Integer. How many times to try before giving up.

Value

The records returned by the API, usually a data frame, with MongoDB date fields as POSIXct in UTC. Stops with a message naming the request, the HTTP status and the server's reason if every attempt fails.
